Free background remover and image converter

BG Studio is a free online tool with two jobs: take the background out of a picture, and convert the result to the format you need. It works in your browser, so nothing is uploaded and there is no queue, signup or watermark.

How do I remove the background from an image?

  1. Drop your image into the page, or click to browse (you can also paste a screenshot).
  2. Pick a method. AI is best for photos of people. Solid color is best for logos, signatures, scans and plain backdrops.
  3. Click Remove background. Fine-tune with Cutout tightness (AI) or Tolerance (Solid color) until the edges look clean.
  4. Choose PNG or WebP to keep the transparent background, then click Convert & download.

Frequently asked questions

Does it use AI?

Yes, there are two methods. AI uses a small portrait-matting model that runs inside your browser (about 26 MB, downloaded once and then cached) and gives the cleanest cutouts of people. Solid color detects and removes a plain background without AI. It is instant and ideal for logos, signatures, scans and product photos on a plain backdrop.

Why does AI mode take longer the first time?

The first run downloads the model to your device. After that it is stored by your browser, so later cutouts start right away. Your image itself is never uploaded.

Which image format should I choose?

PNG is lossless and supports transparency. JPG gives small photos but has no transparency. WebP is smaller than both and keeps transparency. AVIF is usually the smallest, in browsers that support it.

Are my images uploaded or stored?

No. Everything happens on your own device, so your photos stay private.

Is BG Studio really free?

Yes. There is no signup, no watermark and no daily limit. The site is supported by ads and optional donations.

Does it work on my phone?

Yes. The layout adapts to phones and tablets, and you can pick photos straight from your gallery or paste a screenshot. AI mode downloads a 26 MB model once, so use Wi-Fi if you can.

Which image types can I use?

PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF (first frame), BMP and AVIF, up to 25 MB.

Paano alisin ang background ng picture? (Tagalog)

Ang BG Studio ay libreng background remover at image converter na gumagana mismo sa browser mo. Hindi ina-upload ang mga larawan mo, kaya pribado ito.

  1. I-drop, i-paste, o piliin ang larawan mula sa gallery o computer mo.
  2. Piliin ang AI kung may tao sa picture, o Solid color kung logo, pirma, o plain ang background.
  3. I-click ang Remove background. Ayusin ang Cutout tightness (AI) o Tolerance (Solid color) hanggang malinis ang gilid.
  4. I-download bilang PNG o WebP para manatiling transparent, o i-convert sa JPG kung kailangan.

Puwede mo ring i-convert ang PNG, JPG, WebP o AVIF nang hindi inaalis ang background. Pinakamaganda ang Solid color sa ID photo, product photo, logo, at pirma; ang AI naman sa mga larawan ng tao.
